market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver reaching $120 in 18 months requires more than tripling from current levels and more than doubling the all-time high near $50, an extreme move with very low probability even in an inflationary scenario. Historical volatility and fundamental supply/demand dynamics suggest a 0.75% true chance, well below the market's 6.7% implied probability.
evidence_points: Silver's all-time high nominal settlement was $48.70 in 2011; $120 is 2.5x that peak.
Current front-month SI futures are around $32, requiring a 275% gain in under 2 years.
No credible fundamental or monetary catalyst is priced in to support such a breakout.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of precious metal price dynamics and inflation expectations
